whyThisExists: The three caption widgets on page 1 of both forms are named `IN THE`, `COURT OF` and `DIVISION`, and the names do not describe the blanks they cover. Which blank is which was settled by measuring the printed line's own text runs against each widget's /Rect, and that measurement is recorded here so a reviewer can check it rather than take it.

blanks.printedContext: the blank between the printed "IN THE " and " COURT OF"
blanks.printedEvidence: the run "IN THE _" spans x 96.4-149.7, so the printed words end and the underscores begin at x≈142; the underscores close at x≈243 where the run "____ C" begins the word COURT
blanks.conclusion: the widget named `IN THE` covers the COURT TYPE blank
blanks.packetWritesNothingBecause: the platform holds no court-type fact for this route; the clerk answers it and the participant writes it

blanks.printedContext: the blank between the printed " COURT OF " and ", ARKANSAS"
blanks.printedEvidence: the run "OF __" spans x 297.2-333.2, so the printed "OF " ends at x≈318 and the underscores begin there; the run "_, " at x 427.2-441.6 closes the blank before " ARKANSAS"
blanks.conclusion: the widget NAMED `COURT OF` covers the COUNTY blank, not the court
blanks.howItBinds: through a printedLabelCorrection, because the widget's own name matches no descriptor and the caption harvested at it is a bare run of underscores

blanks.printedEvidence: the underscores run x 232.3 to x≈316, where the run "___ DI" begins the word DIVISION
blanks.conclusion: the widget named `DIVISION` does cover the division blank
blanks.packetWritesNothingBecause: the platform holds no division fact, and only some Arkansas courts have divisions

theSameTrapOnTheSiblingFamily: ar-act531-set records the same hazard on its own ACIC forms, shifted differently again: there the county blank is the widget named `COURT 1` and the court blank is named `DIVISION 1`. On neither form do the names settle anything, and on both the geometry does.
